Name: Caleb, Son of Hur
Summary: Son of Hur, firstborn of Ephratah, and father of Shobal, Salma, and Hareph.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:50: Son of Hur, firstborn of Ephratah, and father of Shobal, Salma, and Hareph.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Caleb stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
